title: Executed agreement set
description: Signed MSA, order forms, security addendum, DPA and SLA schedule for each customer, with exception register entries.

title: Obligations register extract
description: Current list of contractual obligations per customer with owners, triggers and status.

title: Incident notification log
description: Per-incident record of detection time, determination time, notice deadlines and notices sent per customer.

title: Subprocessor register and change notices
description: Per-tenant subprocessor list (name, function, data classes, location) with dated change notices.

title: Litigation and claims disclosure certificate
description: Officer-signed annual certificate of pending or threatened litigation, investigations and claims.

title: Data return and deletion certificate
description: Signed certificate of data return and deletion at termination, including backup expiry date.
